comment: Golden corpus for the parse-manual eval harness. home_id + manual_id refer to v2 Firestore docs (homes/{home_id}/manuals/{manual_id}); the runner resolves each PDF from sourceType/sourceRef (upload → Firebase Storage, url → fetch). model mirrors pickParseModel (gas/safety-critical escalate to Opus). Re-pointed from the deleted v1 Supabase to v2 Firebase; corpus rebuilt around live upload manuals in SF Condo, chosen to exercise the curate change (usage/config/unboxing offenders + genuine-maintenance baselines).

manuals.name: nespresso-vertuo
